text: This solution, Doubling of the Residential Building Cap and Levy Adjustment under EQCover (Toka Tū Ake EQC) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in New Zealand between Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake, New Zealand Government, and Private home insurers. The program was implemented in 2022 and focuses on accessibility and collaboration.
